ICT&SM 4.0: Advancing Digital Youth Work for Civic Engagement

Training Course

12-20 February 2027 | Hemmersheim, Germany

The project is designed to equip youth workers with digital skills and tools to strengthen civic participation and engage young people through Information and Communication Technology (ICT).

Strengthen Digital Competencies: Provide practical training in ICT, social media engagement, and digital content creation.

Training overview

This Training Course is

for 35 participants

from Cyprus, Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Norway, Serbia

and recommended for

Youth workers, Youth leaders, Youth coaches, Aspiring youth workers

Accessibility info:
